distribution-consequences-densities.alt: Three panels for one invented country of 40 million people and 400,000 square kilometers. Arithmetic density divides all people by all land: 100 per square kilometer. Physiological density divides all people by the 40,000 square kilometers of arable land: 1,000 per square kilometer. Agricultural density divides the 20 million farmers by arable land: 500 per square kilometer.
